race.title: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: WOODSTOCK CITY has made a bright start for Olly Murphy, and he's narrowly preferred to interesting stable-switcher Gordon Grey . Gallivanted heads the remainder in a competitive conditionals handicap. WOODSTOCK CITY GORDON GREY (IRE) GALLIVANTED (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Woodstock City (13/8), Gallivanted (7/2), Dambuster (6/1), Gordon Grey (6/1), Not At That Price (8/1), A Good Yomp (12/1), Graffiti (14/1), Royal Approval (33/1), Savant Du Mesnil (66/1)
